name: On-wafer S-parameter and noise-parameter characterization of GaN HEMTs from 77 K to 400 K, 2-30 GHz
plain_name: Measure how much electronic noise a gallium-nitride radio transistor adds between 77 K and 400 K
description: Two-finger AlGaN/GaN HEMTs on SiC are probed on-wafer with GSG RF probes in an LN2-cooled, evacuated Lake Shore probe station with a Model 336 controller; a Keysight PNA-X with built-in source tuner and noise receiver extracts NFmin, gain and optimum source reflection from 77 K to 400 K over 2-30 GHz (VDS 5 V, VGS -2 V).
keywords: Measure how much electronic noise a gallium-nitride radio transistor adds between 77 K and 400 K

sources.citation: On-wafer Characterisation of Noise Parameters of GaN HEMTs between 77 K and 400 K (Wang et al., 103rd ARFTG Microwave Measurement Conference, 2024, doi:10.1109/ARFTG61196.2024.10661062)

reported_equipment: Wessington Cryogenics 60 L liquid nitrogen Dewar

requirements.rationale: The measurement temperature range was 77 K to 400 K.
RF probes and cabling must carry signals up to 30 GHz.
Two-port S-parameter and noise measurement lands a GSG probe on the gate port and one on the drain port.
The probe-station sample space is evacuated by a vacuum pump.
The HEMT is DC biased and RF measured through the probes.
Optional: the source cooled the station with liquid nitrogen from a 60 L dewar.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
